title: Unit 12: More to Explore: Emphatic Structures, Cleft Sentences & Discovery
objective: Mampu menggunakan passive report structures dan passive dengan dua objek untuk menyampaikan informasi secara formal dan persuasif, serta menguasai kosakata geografis dan kolokasi verb + noun

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan passive report structures yang sering digunakan dalam bahasa formal dan akademik untuk melaporkan kepercayaan, pengetahuan, atau pendapat. Struktur ini membuat kalimat lebih objektif dan impersonal. Selain itu, unit ini juga membahas passive voice dengan dua objek (direct dan indirect object).
rules: Passive report structure: It + be + past participle + that clause. Contoh: It is thought that thousands of caves exist in China.
Passive report dengan to + infinitive untuk beliefs/knowledge tentang people/things. Contoh: She is said to be one of the greatest explorers of all time.
Passive report dengan to + have + past participle untuk beliefs/knowledge tentang actions. Contoh: Many people are known to have died on the expedition.
Passive dengan dua objek - Verb + indirect object + direct object: The teacher read the children a story. Menjadi passivenya: The children were read a story ATAU A story was read to the children.
Untuk passive dengan dua objek, lebih umum menggunakan person sebagai subject dari passive construction, bukan object.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Memilih Subject yang Salah dalam Passive dengan Dua Objek
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar salah memilih subject saat membuat passive dari kalimat dengan dua objek. Meskipun secara gramatikal kedua bentuk benar, dalam bahasa Inggris natural lebih umum menggunakan person (indirect object) sebagai subject, bukan thing (direct object).
commonTrap.wrong: A lot of money was paid to her.
commonTrap.correct: She was paid a lot of money.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah kalimat bahasa Inggris berikut yang menggunakan passive report structure dengan benar untuk menyampaikan informasi secara formal dan impersonal?
options: It is believed that the glacier has been retreating for decades.
People believe it that the glacier has been retreating for decades.
The glacier is believing to have been retreating for decades.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi pertama menggunakan passive report structure yang benar: It + is + past participle (believed) + that clause. Opsi kedua salah karena 'People believe it that...' bukan struktur yang gramatikal. Opsi ketiga salah karena 'believe' tidak bisa digunakan dalam bentuk continuous passive ('is believing') dalam konteks ini; seharusnya 'is believed to have been retreating'.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Dalam passive voice dengan dua objek, bentuk mana yang paling natural dan umum digunakan dalam bahasa Inggris untuk kalimat aktif 'The committee awarded Dr. Hasan a research grant'?
options: A research grant was awarded to Dr. Hasan by the committee.
Dr. Hasan was awarded a research grant by the committee.
A research grant was awarded Dr. Hasan by the committee.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris, ketika membuat passive dari kalimat dengan dua objek, lebih natural dan umum menggunakan person (indirect object) sebagai subject. Jadi 'Dr. Hasan was awarded a research grant' lebih natural daripada 'A research grant was awarded to Dr. Hasan'. Opsi ketiga salah karena menghilangkan preposisi 'to' yang diperlukan jika thing menjadi subject.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Perhatikan percakapan berikut tentang eksplorasi geografi. Isilah bagian [...] dengan respons yang paling tepat dan natural.

Anna: "I heard that the expedition to the hostile desert region was extremely dangerous."
Ben: "Yes, [...]"
options: many explorers are known to have died attempting to cross the uninhabitable dunes.
many explorers know to have died attempting to cross the uninhabitable dunes.
many explorers are known that they died attempting to cross the uninhabitable dunes.
readinessQuestions.explanation: Opsi pertama menggunakan passive report structure dengan benar: subject + are known + to have + past participle, yang cocok untuk melaporkan pengetahuan tentang tindakan di masa lalu. Opsi kedua salah karena 'know to have died' bukan passive — seharusnya 'are known to have died'. Opsi ketiga salah karena mencampurkan dua pola; 'are known that they died' bukan struktur yang gramatikal — pola 'that clause' hanya digunakan dengan 'It is known that...'.

vocab.collocation: Deep, dark, cold and often uninhabitable: caves remain one of the least explored places on Earth.
There's often snow on the top of a very high reef.
When water goes over the edge of a dune, it often looks white.
It can take a very long time for a glacier to move even as little as ten centimetres.
The deepest and darkest place in the ocean is totally hostile to human life.
The Voronya Cave is so inaccessible and inhospitable that very little is known about it.
Which of the creatures do you think are endangered?
They wanted to take revenge on the native people.

dialogue.context: Percakapan antara dua siswa membahas pesan tersembunyi dalam kalimat yang mereka dengar dari orang lain

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: That's an interesting jumper you're wearing.
lines.translation: Itu sweater yang menarik yang kamu pakai.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Thanks! But wait, do you think she really meant it was interesting, or was she being polite?
lines.translation: Terima kasih! Tapi tunggu, menurutmu dia benar-benar menganggapnya menarik, atau dia cuma sopan?

lines.speaker: Anna
lines.text: There's an earlier train you could catch, if you want.
lines.translation: Ada kereta lebih awal yang bisa kamu naiki, kalau kamu mau.

lines.speaker: Ben
lines.text: Hmm, that sounds like she wants me to leave earlier. People don't always say what they really mean!
lines.translation: Hmm, kedengarannya seperti dia ingin aku pergi lebih awal. Orang tidak selalu mengatakan apa yang mereka maksud sebenarnya!

speakingLab.context: Latihan berbicara persuasif tentang aktivitas manusia dan dampaknya terhadap dunia alami

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hi there! Today we're going to discuss how human activity affects the natural world. Can you give me a real-life example of what forests are being turned into these days?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, forests are being turned into fields to grow food, and trees are being cut down to get wood.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent example! Now, what other problems can human activity cause? Think about animals specifically.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Human activity causes habitat loss, and many animals are being pushed towards extinction because of it.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very thoughtful answer! One more question: Do you think there might be problems if people explore the deep ocean or caves extensively? What kind of problems?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I think exploration could disturb unique ecosystems that haven't been touched by humans. It might harm species we haven't even discovered yet.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses a passive report structure?
options: People believe that thousands of caves exist in China.
It is believed that thousands of caves exist in China.
It believes that thousands of caves exist in China.
quiz.answer: It is believed that thousands of caves exist in China.
quiz.explanation: Passive report structure menggunakan pola: It + be + past participle + that clause. Pilihan pertama adalah active voice, pilihan ketiga salah karena 'it believes' tidak gramatikal.

quiz.question: Rewrite using passive report structure: 'Experts know that Death Valley is the hottest place on Earth.' Which is correct?
options: Death Valley is known to be the hottest place on Earth.
Death Valley knows to be the hottest place on Earth.
It knows that Death Valley is the hottest place on Earth.
quiz.answer: Death Valley is known to be the hottest place on Earth.
quiz.explanation: Untuk passive report tentang beliefs/knowledge, kita gunakan: subject + be + past participle + to + infinitive. 'Death Valley is known to be' adalah struktur yang benar.

quiz.question: Which passive sentence is MORE usual in English? 'They gave Rondon the job.'
options: The job was given to Rondon.
Rondon was given the job.
Both are equally common.
quiz.explanation: Dalam passive dengan dua objek, lebih umum menggunakan person (Rondon) sebagai subject daripada thing (the job). Meskipun kedua bentuk gramatikal, 'Rondon was given the job' lebih natural.

quiz.question: Complete: 'People say this cave is 500 metres deep.' → 'This cave _____ 500 metres deep.'
options: is said to be
is said being
says to be
quiz.explanation: Passive report structure untuk beliefs menggunakan: be + said/thought/believed + to + infinitive. Jadi 'is said to be' adalah jawaban yang benar.

quiz.question: Which word means 'not moving at all'?
options: motionless
aggressive
intently
quiz.explanation: Motionless artinya tidak bergerak sama sekali. Aggressive berarti agresif/kasar, sedangkan intently berarti dengan penuh perhatian.

quiz.question: What is the correct collocation? 'They wanted to _____ revenge on the native people.'
options: make
take
do
quiz.explanation: Kolokasi yang benar adalah 'take revenge' (membalas dendam). Kita tidak menggunakan 'make revenge' atau 'do revenge' dalam bahasa Inggris.
